lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: What is that? What is that thing doing on B3?

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: Let them file out. Let them tell themselves the quarter is clean.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: Hawkes Biomedical. Category owner. A valuation that makes Zurich sit up straight and ask how high.
lines.audioText: Hawkes Biomedical. Category owner. A valuation that makes Zurich sit up straight and ask how high.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: I told Hale B3 stays dark. I told Voss patients are the product. And I meant every word.
lines.audioText: I told Hale B3 stays dark. I told Voss patients are the product. And I meant every word.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: Dominance isn't a slide. It's this city looking up at fifty-eight and knowing the ceiling is mine.
lines.audioText: Dominance isn't a slide. It's this city looking up at fifty-eight and knowing the ceiling is mine.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: So why does the glass still look like it's keeping something in.
lines.audioText: So why does the glass still look like it's keeping something in.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: There's a smell under the multiples. Something rotten in the basement I keep calling a rounding error.
lines.audioText: There's a smell under the multiples. Something rotten in the basement I keep calling a rounding error.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: Oh my god! What is that thing?!
lines.audioText: Oh my god! What is that thing?!

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: It ran. The vat went with it.
lines.audioText: It ran. The vat went with it.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: AAAAH— it's burning! Get it off me!
lines.audioText: AAAAH— it's burning! Get it off me!

lines.speaker: Metamorphosis

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: What happened to me? I can still hear myself. I can still think. But these are not my hands. That thing ran into the glass, and I am looking down, and it is me. I am still in here. And I am that now.
lines.audioText: What happened to me? I can still hear myself. I can still think. But these are not my hands. That thing ran into the glass, and I am looking down, and it is me. I am still in here. And I am that now.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: Doors shut. Good. The board can sit up there and pretend the numbers still mean something.
lines.audioText: Doors shut. Good. The board can sit up there and pretend the numbers still mean something.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: That alarm was not a drill. I saw the monitor. After the klaxon. After they left me the office like a gift.
lines.audioText: That alarm was not a drill. I saw the monitor. After the klaxon. After they left me the office like a gift.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: It looked like a creature. Not a chart. Not a leak. Something with a shape it should not have, sitting on a terminal in my tower.
lines.audioText: It looked like a creature. Not a chart. Not a leak. Something with a shape it should not have, sitting on a terminal in my tower.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: Hawkes sells dominance. Clean floors. Locked basements. We do not put animals on a fifty-eighth-floor screen and call it operations.
lines.audioText: Hawkes sells dominance. Clean floors. Locked basements. We do not put animals on a fifty-eighth-floor screen and call it operations.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: Unless it was not an animal. Unless B3 has been writing back. That is not a valuation problem. That is a thing in the building.
lines.audioText: Unless it was not an animal. Unless B3 has been writing back. That is not a valuation problem. That is a thing in the building.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: I am going down there. If it is a glitch, I will bury the tape. If it is not—
lines.audioText: I am going down there. If it is a glitch, I will bury the tape. If it is not—

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: The elevator is going up. I am still in it. That is the only part I trust.
lines.audioText: The elevator is going up. I am still in it. That is the only part I trust.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: There was a thing in the lab. It ran at the glass. The vat broke, and it burned, and I went down.
lines.audioText: There was a thing in the lab. It ran at the glass. The vat broke, and it burned, and I went down.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: After that I am reconstructing. These are not the hands I took into that room. I keep waiting for them to change back.
lines.audioText: After that I am reconstructing. These are not the hands I took into that room. I keep waiting for them to change back.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: Hale thinks I walked out of a meeting. She is going to the other investors. She has not seen what is riding this elevator.
lines.audioText: Hale thinks I walked out of a meeting. She is going to the other investors. She has not seen what is riding this elevator.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: If this is my mind failing, the doors will open on a man I recognize. If it is not, then I found the thing. I am wearing it.
lines.audioText: If this is my mind failing, the doors will open on a man I recognize. If it is not, then I found the thing. I am wearing it.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: I need a mirror. I need a face I already know. If I am inventing this, the glass will say so.
lines.audioText: I need a mirror. I need a face I already know. If I am inventing this, the glass will say so.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: I appreciate you all taking the time. I know calendars at this altitude fill themselves with golf and liability.
lines.audioText: I appreciate you all taking the time. I know calendars at this altitude fill themselves with golf and liability.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: We are not just building a product here. This is about absolute market dominance. Anyone still talking share is already losing.
lines.audioText: We are not just building a product here. This is about absolute market dominance. Anyone still talking share is already losing.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: Some of you have gotten comfortable. Comfortable is how empires get carved up by people hungrier than you. That ends in this room.
lines.audioText: Some of you have gotten comfortable. Comfortable is how empires get carved up by people hungrier than you. That ends in this room.

lines.audioText: The street is watching B3, Pierce. If that basement leaks, the valuation does not survive the quarter.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: B3 stays dark because I told it to stay dark. Compliance does not set the ceiling. I do.
lines.audioText: B3 stays dark because I told it to stay dark. Compliance does not set the ceiling. I do.

lines.text: Ethics and the charter say we seal it. Those are patients down there, Pierce. Not prototypes.
lines.audioText: Ethics and the charter say we seal it. Those are patients down there, Pierce. Not prototypes.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.text: Patients are the product. The ones who walk out of here will write our next decade. The ones who don't were never going to.
lines.audioText: Patients are the product. The ones who walk out of here will write our next decade. The ones who don't were never going to.
